VBO:0200928.summary: The Large and Small Münsterländer are separate German pointing breeds, not two sizes of one breed. Both belong to the longhaired pointing-dog tradition, with different documented breeding histories.
VBO:0200928.shortDescription: Large and Small Münsterländers are separate breeds within the German longhaired pointing tradition.
